subject: Request: Executive consent for one-off sandbox uplift and waiver
messages:
From: Priya Rao <pri.rao@astranova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: AstraNova Procurement <procurement@astranova.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: extended sandbox + additional credits for regulated testing

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from our side — the regulator pushed our internal test window and as a result we need an extra runway to complete the controlled lab tests. The current PLG sandbox limits and the 30‑day trial are not long enough for the safety/validation steps our compliance team requires.

Can Redwood approve a 60‑day extension on the sandbox and an additional 75k credits to cover the inference runs? Without this we risk delaying our integration decision by another quarter. We appreciate the partnership — happy to sign a short pilot addendum that includes a mutual action plan and measurable success criteria.

Attached: high‑level test plan (PDF stub).

Best,
Priya Rao
Director of AI Platforms
AstraNova Therapeutics

---
Attachments: test_plan_summary.pdf (PDF)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Rao <pri.rao@astranova.com>, AstraNova Procurement <procurement@astranova.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: extended sandbox + additional credits for regulated testing

Folks — forwarding Priya's ask. TL;DR: AstraNova needs an extra runway (60 days) + 75k credits. They will sign a short addendum with KPIs (pass safety gating, latency <150ms p95 on sample payload).

Why I think we should consider:
- AstraNova is a strategic prospect in oncology workflows (large ARR potential if they go GA).
- They hit a regulator scheduling issue — not product failure.
- This is time‑bound and can convert quickly to a committed Dedicated contract if thresholds met.

Risks: this exceeds our standard PLG cap and sets a precedent. Finance/legal will push back without constraints.

Proposal from my side: executive one‑off approval with controls — require:
1) Signed pilot addendum (we have a draft)
2) Mutual Action Plan in Drive (I'll share)
3) KPI gates and a commitment meeting at day 30 to evaluate
4) Limit to a single extension; approvals for further uplift require CRO/CFO signoff

I've attached the MAP and draft agreement for review. Please advise whether we can escalate to Aditya/CEO for signoff or if CFO should own the final number.

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: AstraNova_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx, pilot_agreement_draft.pdf

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extended sandbox + additional credits for regulated testing

Thanks for the context, Marissa. A few clarifying items before I approve anything one‑off:
1) Legal — will the pilot addendum include standard indemnities and a data handling clause suitable for regulated workflows? We cannot take unvetted data exposures.
2) Finance — what is the estimated ARR conversion probability if we grant the uplift? Please provide a short revenue bridge and expected timeline.
3) KPIs — propose a gated approval: approve a shorter runway initially (30 days) and a tranche of credits (40k). If they hit the agreed milestones by day 30, then I will authorize the remaining credits and another 15–30 days extension.

I don't want to block the deal but we must balance risk. If Legal/Finance are comfortable with the addendum and we put a DocuSign path in place, I'm prepared to sign off on the conditional approach above.

Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

---
Questions for Marissa: please confirm the ARR expectation and confirm Legal has the addendum redlines by EOD Friday so we can proceed to DocuSign next week.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Priya Rao <pri.rao@astranova.com>, AstraNova Procurement <procurement@astranova.com>

Looping back with final executive decision. After reviewing the MAP, draft addendum, and finance notes (Marissa — thanks for the bridge), we're approving a one‑off, conditional uplift as follows:

Decision: Approve a 45‑day sandbox extension + 50k free credits (one‑time). Conditions:
- Signed pilot addendum via DocuSign (link below).
- KPI gate at day 30: pass safety gating and demonstrate inference latency p95 <150ms on our sample workload.
- Single extension only — any further exceptions require CRO/CFO signoff.
- Procurement to acknowledge that credits are promotional and non-refundable; conversion path must be discussed at day 30 checkpoint.

Marissa, please execute the DocuSign addendum and attach the MAP to the Doc. Kimberly — please record the concession in Deal Desk (HubSpot) and log the addendum link. Priya — appreciate your flexibility; once the DocuSign is complete we'll enable the credits and extend the sandbox.
